name: smwgraphics-super-metroid-norfair-descent
title: Super Metroid - Norfair Descent
description:
Background from the vertical rooms of Norfair in Super Metroid. It uses palette 1 and one ExGFX file in BG1.

This download contains two different variants of the palette from the game.

This background would be most useful for a vertical cave section, or maybe a rising lava section.

Credit is not needed, but it would still be appreciated.
